description:
Every stock offering, at-the-market (ATM) program, convertible note (including private Rule 144A deals announced
only in an 8-K), notes exchanged for shares, unregistered share sale and shelf registration the company filed with
the SEC, plus the company's 8-K filings of the last 30 days in plain English, with size, price per share, and how the stock reacted (day 1, day 2,
1 week, 1 month vs the prior close); the share-count trend (1-year change, 3-year yearly rate); and a 0–100
dilution-risk score with reasons (recent offerings, active shelf, cash burn, heavy stock pay). Use for 'has SOFI
diluted shareholders?', 'what happened to the price after the last offering?', 'is a share sale likely?'.
